comment: With/without-DoFlow A/B (plan: agent-docs/briefs/ab-bench-plan-result.md). Arm A is bare Claude (empty scratch HOME), arm B has DoFlow installed in its scratch HOME (decision D1: --mcp none). maxTokensPerRun and maxBudgetUsd are null on purpose: execute refuses until the user approves both at run time (config edit, or --max-tokens-per-run and --max-budget-usd). maxBudgetUsd is passed to every Claude run as --max-budget-usd, a hard dollar stop beside the token cap. Credentials enter only through the environment variables named in credentialEnv.
